_comment: Album folders deliberately HELD OUT of catalog-manifest.json, with the reason.
deploy/check-manifest.mjs subtracts these before deciding staleness, so the Step 0
gate stays meaningful: anything NOT on this list that is missing from the manifest is
an accident and blocks the publish (exit 3). Anything on this list is a known, reviewed
deferral and is reported separately as HELD.
A hold is not a way to silence the gate. Each entry needs a reason and an owner decision.
Clear an entry by making the decision, then re-running deploy/rebuild-manifest.mjs.

holds.reason: The `prayers` category has never existed in catalog-manifest.json. Surfacing 140 prayer albums means creating a NEW public category on the site, which needs a curated category key + human-facing label and a decision about whether prayers belong in the main browse surface at all. rebuild-manifest.mjs correctly refuses to guess a category.
holds.unblocks: add a { key, label, artists: [...] } category to the manifest (or map prayers/<artist> onto an existing category), then re-run deploy/rebuild-manifest.mjs --apply

holds.reason: The `hebrew` category has never existed in the manifest. Single album (LHTW1001EN-the-first-visit). Same decision shape as `prayers` — a new public category.
holds.unblocks: same as prayers/, or file the album under an existing category

holds.reason: Not a new album — a disk anomaly. `faith-based/ron-tank/` holds a `tracks/` folder directly at the ARTIST level (alongside desktop.ini), so structural album-detection sees the artist folder as an album. Ron Tank's actual album is already in the manifest. Nothing to add; the loose tracks/ folder should be filed into an album folder or removed.
